<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Pita Gastronomia | Catering Corporativo para Feiras e Grandes Eventos</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Catering corporativo para feiras, congressos, confraternizações e grandes eventos de 200 a 1500 convidados em SP e RJ." />

  <style>
    :root {
      --dark: #17110d;
      --brown: #4a2f22;
      --gold: #c79a5b;
      --gold-light: #e8d1aa;
      --cream: #f8f3eb;
      --off: #fffaf3;
      --text: #30241d;
      --muted: #6d5b50;
      --white: #ffffff;
      --shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(23, 17, 13, .14);
      --radius: 24px;
    }

    * {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      font-family: "Inter", "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--off);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    a {
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    .container {
      width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 40px));
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    .topbar {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      z-index: 10;
      background: rgba(23, 17, 13, .84);
      backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }

    .nav {
      min-height: 76px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 24px;
    }

    .brand {
      color: var(--white);
      letter-spacing: .12em;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .brand span {
      display: block;
      color: var(--gold-light);
      font-size: .68rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: .18em;
      margin-top: 3px;
    }

    .menu {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 22px;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.82);
      font-size: .9rem;
    }

    .menu a:hover {
      color: var(--gold-light);
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 700;
      transition: .25s ease;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      font-size: .95rem;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: var(--gold);
      color: var(--dark);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(199, 154, 91, .28);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      background: #d8aa6b;
    }

    .btn-outline {
      color: var(--white);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.35);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
    }

    .btn-outline:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.16);
    }

    .hero {
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 150px 0 90px;
      color: var(--white);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      background:
        linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(23,17,13,.92) 0%, rgba(23,17,13,.78) 43%, rgba(23,17,13,.38) 100%),
        url("img/hero-home.jpg") center/cover no-repeat;
    }

    .hero::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: auto -10% -28% -10%;
      height: 300px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(199,154,91,.28), transparent 65%);
    }

    .hero-grid {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.08fr .72fr;
      gap: 50px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      color: var(--gold-light);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      font-size: .78rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .eyebrow::before {
      content: "";
      width: 42px;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--gold);
    }

    h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 5.35rem);
      line-height: .98;
      letter-spacing: -.055em;
      max-width: 840px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .hero-sub {
      font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.82);
      max-width: 700px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .hero-highlight {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border: 1px solid rgba(232,209,170,.28);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--gold);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 20px 22px;
      font-size: 1.12rem;
      max-width: 720px;
      color: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 20px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.14);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      gap: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .hero-card {
      background: rgba(255,250,243,.94);
      color: var(--text);
      padding: 32px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);
    }

    .hero-card strong {
      font-size: 3.2rem;
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--brown);
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .hero-card p {
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-bottom: 22px;
    }

    .hero-card .mini {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .mini-item {
      padding: 16px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,47,34,.08);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    section {
      padding: 92px 0;
    }

    .section-head {
      max-width: 780px;
      margin-bottom: 42px;
    }

    .section-head.center {
      text-align: center;
      margin-left: auto;
      margin-right: auto;
    }

    h2 {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.2rem);
      line-height: 1.05;
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
      color: var(--dark);
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .lead {
      font-size: 1.12rem;
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .cards-3 {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 22px;
    }

    .card {
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 34px;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(23,17,13,.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,47,34,.08);
      min-height: 240px;
    }

    .card .number {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--cream);
      color: var(--brown);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 900;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .card h3 {
      font-size: 1.35rem;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      color: var(--brown);
    }

    .personalizacao {
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(74,47,34,.95), rgba(23,17,13,.94)),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555244162-803834f70033?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1600&q=80") center/cover no-repeat;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .personalizacao h2,
    .personalizacao .lead {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .split {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: .9fr 1.1fr;
      gap: 50px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .feature-box {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 34px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }

    .check-list {
      display: grid;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .check-list div {
      padding: 14px 16px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
    }

    .quote {
      margin-top: 26px;
      color: var(--gold-light);
      font-size: 1.24rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      line-height: 1.35;
    }

    .founder {
      background: var(--cream);
    }

    .founder-card {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: .8fr 1.2fr;
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 34px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .founder-photo {
      min-height: 560px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(23,17,13,.05), rgba(23,17,13,.18)),
        url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center center/cover no-repeat;
      background-color:#f8f3eb;
    }

    .founder-text {
      padding: 54px;
    }

    .tag {
      display: inline-block;
      background: var(--cream);
      color: var(--brown);
      padding: 9px 14px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: .82rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }

    .stats {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 34px;
    }

    .stat {
      background: var(--white);
      padding: 24px 18px;
      border-radius: 20px;
      text-align: center;
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,47,34,.08);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(23,17,13,.06);
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--brown);
    }

    .centers {
      background: var(--dark);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .centers h2,
    .centers .lead {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .logo-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .logo-item {
      min-height: 100px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.07);
      border-radius: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 20px;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--gold-light);
    }

    .services-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .service {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 26px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,47,34,.08);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(23,17,13,.06);
    }

    .service h3 {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      color: var(--brown);
    }

    .end-year {
      background: var(--cream);
    }

    .agency {
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .portfolio-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.2fr .8fr 1fr;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .portfolio-grid div {
      min-height: 260px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    }

    .portfolio-grid .tall {
      min-height: 540px;
      grid-row: span 2;
    }

    .p1 { background-image: url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1505236858219-8359eb29e329?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80"); }
    .p2 { background-image: url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1540575467063-178a50c2df87?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80"); }
    .p3 { background-image: url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551218808-94e220e084d2?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80"); }
    .p4 { background-image: url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1527529482837-4698179dc6ce?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80"); }
    .p5 { background-image: url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1511795409834-ef04bbd61622?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=80"); }

    .cta {
      background:
        linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(23,17,13,.94), rgba(74,47,34,.88)),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1414235077428-338989a2e8c0?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1600&q=80") center/cover no-repeat;
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .cta h2,
    .cta .lead {
      color: var(--white);
    }

    form {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 34px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.1);
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    }

    input,
    select {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px 18px;
      border-radius: 14px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.92);
      color: var(--text);
      font-size: .98rem;
      outline: none;
    }

    .full {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
    }

    .form-button {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      border: none;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 17px 24px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--gold);
      color: var(--dark);
      font-weight: 900;
      font-size: 1rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    footer {
      background: #100c09;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,.74);
      padding: 34px 0;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: .92rem;
    }

    @media (max-width: 980px) {
      .menu {
        display: none;
      }

      .hero-grid,
      .split,
      .founder-card {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .cards-3,
      .services-grid,
      .logo-grid,
      .stats {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .founder-photo {
      min-height: 560px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(23,17,13,.05), rgba(23,17,13,.18)),
        url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center center/cover no-repeat;
      background-color:#f8f3eb;
    }

      .portfolio-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      }

      .portfolio-grid .tall {
        min-height: 320px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .container {
        width: min(100% - 28px, 1180px);
      }

      .hero {
        padding-top: 120px;
      }

      .hero-card,
      .founder-text {
        padding: 28px;
      }

      .cards-3,
      .services-grid,
      .logo-grid,
      .stats,
      .portfolio-grid,
      form {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }

      .full,
      .form-button {
        grid-column: auto;
      }

      section {
        padding: 70px 0;
      }
    }

    /* =========================
       ANIMAÇÕES & EFEITOS PREMIUM
    ========================= */

    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(34px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }

    @keyframes floatCard {
      0%, 100% {
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
      50% {
        transform: translateY(-14px);
      }
    }

    @keyframes heroZoom {
      0% {
        background-size: 100%;
      }
      100% {
        background-size: 108%;
      }
    }

    @keyframes shine {
      0% {
        left: -120%;
      }
      100% {
        left: 120%;
      }
    }

    .hero {
      animation: heroZoom 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .hero h1,
    .hero .hero-sub,
    .hero-highlight,
    .hero-actions,
    .section-head,
    .card,
    .service,
    .stat,
    .logo-item,
    .founder-card,
    .feature-box,
    .portfolio-grid div,
    form {
      animation: fadeUp .9s ease both;
      animation-timeline: view();
      animation-range: entry 0% cover 26%;
    }

    .hero h1 {
      animation: fadeUp .9s ease .1s both;
    }

    .hero .hero-sub {
      animation: fadeUp .9s ease .22s both;
    }

    .hero-highlight {
      animation: fadeUp .9s ease .34s both;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      animation: fadeUp .9s ease .46s both;
    }

    .hero-card {
      animation: floatCard 5.5s ease-in-out infinite, fadeIn 1s ease .4s both;
    }

    .btn {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .btn::after,
    .form-button::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: -120%;
      width: 80%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,.35), transparent);
      transform: skewX(-18deg);
    }

    .btn:hover::after,
    .form-button:hover::after {
      animation: shine .8s ease;
    }

    .menu a {
      position: relative;
      padding-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .menu a::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 0;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--gold-light);
      transition: width .25s ease;
    }

    .menu a:hover::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    .card,
    .service,
    .stat,
    .logo-item,
    .portfolio-grid div {
      transition: transform .32s ease, box-shadow .32s ease, border-color .32s ease, filter .32s ease;
    }

    .card:hover,
    .service:hover,
    .stat:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgba(23,17,13,.14);
      border-color: rgba(199,154,91,.34);
    }

    .logo-item:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      background: rgba(199,154,91,.14);
      border-color: rgba(232,209,170,.36);
    }

    .portfolio-grid div {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .portfolio-grid div::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 45%, rgba(23,17,13,.34));
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity .32s ease;
    }

    .portfolio-grid div:hover {
      transform: scale(1.025);
      filter: saturate(1.08) contrast(1.04);
    }

    .portfolio-grid div:hover::after {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .feature-box,
    .hero-card,
    form {
      transition: transform .32s ease, box-shadow .32s ease;
    }

    .feature-box:hover,
    form:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.18);
    }

    input,
    select {
      transition: transform .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease;
    }

    input:focus,
    select:focus {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: var(--gold);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(199,154,91,.18);
    }

    .form-button {
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform .25s ease, background .25s ease;
    }

    .form-button:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      background: #d8aa6b;
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *,
      *::before,
      *::after {
        animation-duration: .01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        scroll-behavior: auto !important;
        transition-duration: .01ms !important;
      }
    }

  
    /* =========================
       RESPONSIVO + HOVER PREMIUM
    ========================= */

    .mobile-toggle {
      display: none;
      width: 46px;
      height: 46px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: .25s ease;
    }

    .mobile-toggle:hover {
      background: var(--gold);
      color: var(--dark);
      transform: rotate(90deg);
    }

    .brand img {
      transition: transform .35s ease, filter .35s ease;
    }

    .brand:hover img {
      transform: scale(1.06);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 22px rgba(199,154,91,.28));
    }

    .card:hover .number {
      background: var(--gold);
      color: var(--dark);
      transform: rotate(8deg) scale(1.08);
    }

    .number {
      transition: .3s ease;
    }

    .service:hover h3 {
      color: var(--gold);
    }

    .service:hover {
      transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.015);
    }

    .stat:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.03);
      background: var(--brown);
      color: var(--gold-light);
    }

    .hero-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.015);
      box-shadow: 0 32px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
    }

    .mini-item {
      transition: .28s ease;
    }

    .mini-item:hover {
      background: var(--brown);
      color: var(--gold-light);
      transform: translateX(8px);
    }

    @media (max-width: 980px) {
      .mobile-toggle {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
      }

      .topbar .btn-primary {
        display: none;
      }

      .menu {
        position: absolute;
        top: 76px;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        display: none;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
        gap: 0;
        background: rgba(23, 17, 13, .97);
        border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
        padding: 14px 20px 24px;
      }

      .menu.active {
        display: flex;
        animation: fadeUp .35s ease both;
      }

      .menu a {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 14px 0;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);
      }

      .hero {
        min-height: auto;
        padding: 125px 0 70px;
        animation: none;
        background-size: cover !important;
      }

      .hero-grid {
        gap: 34px;
      }

      .hero-card {
        animation: fadeUp .9s ease .4s both;
      }

      .founder-photo {
      min-height: 560px;
      background:
        linear-gradient(rgba(23,17,13,.05), rgba(23,17,13,.18)),
        url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center center/cover no-repeat;
      background-color:#f8f3eb;
    }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .nav {
        min-height: 72px;
      }

      .brand img {
        height: 56px !important;
      }

      .menu {

    .home-gallery { background: var(--off); }

    .gallery-block {
      margin-top: 34px;
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 30px;
      background: var(--white);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(23,17,13,.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,47,34,.08);
      transition: transform .35s ease, box-shadow .35s ease;
    }

    .gallery-block:hover {
      transform: translateY(-8px);
      box-shadow: 0 28px 80px rgba(23,17,13,.14);
    }

    .gallery-title { margin-bottom: 18px; }

    .gallery-title span {
      color: var(--gold);
      font-size: .78rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: .16em;
      font-weight: 900;
    }

    .gallery-title h3 {
      font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 3vw, 2.2rem);
      color: var(--brown);
      margin: 6px 0 6px;
      letter-spacing: -.03em;
    }

    .gallery-title p { color: var(--muted); }

    .banner-preview,
    .photo-grid div {
      min-height: 380px;
      border-radius: 24px;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      transition: transform .35s ease, filter .35s ease;
    }

    .banner-preview:hover,
    .photo-grid div:hover {
      transform: scale(1.018);
      filter: saturate(1.08) contrast(1.05);
    }

    .photo-grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 18px;
    }

    .photo-grid.three { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
    .photo-grid.two { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

    .photo-grid small {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      bottom: 16px;
      background: rgba(23,17,13,.72);
      color: #fff;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 800;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }

    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .photo-grid.three,
      .photo-grid.two { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }

      .banner-preview,
      .photo-grid div { min-height: 310px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 560px) {
      .gallery-block {
        padding: 18px;
        border-radius: 22px;
      }

      .banner-preview,
      .photo-grid div {
        min-height: 250px;
        border-radius: 18px;
      }
    }

  
    .photo-grid div,
    .banner-preview {
      background-attachment: scroll;
    }

    .gallery-block:hover .photo-grid div small {
      background: rgba(199,154,91,.92);
      color: #17110d;
    }

    .photo-grid div::before,
    .banner-preview::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(120deg, rgba(255,255,255,.0), rgba(255,255,255,.22), rgba(255,255,255,.0));
      transform: translateX(-120%);
      transition: transform .75s ease;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .photo-grid div:hover::before,
    .banner-preview:hover::before {
      transform: translateX(120%);
    }

    .photo-grid small {
      z-index: 2;
      transition: .3s ease;
    }

  
    .gallery-block.destaque {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff, #f8f3eb);
    }
    .banner-preview {
      min-height: 520px;
      border-radius: 26px;
      background-size: cover;
      background-position: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow);
      transition: transform .35s ease, filter .35s ease;
    }
    .banner-preview:hover {
      transform: scale(1.012);
      filter: saturate(1.06) contrast(1.04);
    }
    @media (max-width: 700px) {
      .banner-preview { min-height: 320px; }
    }

    /* ===== Empresas que confiam ===== */
    .clients { background: var(--white); }
    .clients-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .client-item {
      min-height: 92px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 18px 14px;
      border-radius: 18px;
      background: var(--cream);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,47,34,.1);
      color: var(--brown);
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: .04em;
      font-size: 1.02rem;
      transition: transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, background .3s ease;
    }
    .client-item:hover {
      transform: translateY(-6px);
      background: var(--brown);
      color: var(--gold-light);
      box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(23,17,13,.14);
    }
    .clients h3.sub {
      margin: 44px 0 18px;
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      color: var(--brown);
      letter-spacing: -.02em;
    }
    @media (max-width: 980px) { .clients-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    @media (max-width: 640px) { .clients-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } .client-item { min-height: 76px; font-size: .92rem; } }

    /* ===== Números da Pita ===== */
    .numbers { background: var(--cream); }
    .numbers-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 18px;
    }
    .number-card {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid rgba(74,47,34,.08);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 36px rgba(23,17,13,.06);
      padding: 38px 26px;
      text-align: center;
      transition: transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease;
    }
    .number-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 26px 70px rgba(23,17,13,.14); }
    .number-card strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
      line-height: 1;
      color: var(--brown);
      letter-spacing: -.04em;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .number-card strong span { color: var(--gold); }
    .number-card p { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }
    @media (max-width: 980px) { .numbers-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
    @media (max-width: 640px) { .numbers-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

    /* ===== Botão fixo WhatsApp ===== */
    .whats-float {
      position: fixed;
      right: 22px;
      bottom: 22px;
      z-index: 50;
      width: 62px;
      height: 62px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #25d366;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(37,211,102,.45);
      transition: transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
      animation: whatsPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    .whats-float:hover { transform: scale(1.1); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgba(37,211,102,.55); }
    .whats-float svg { width: 34px; height: 34px; fill: #fff; }
    @keyframes whatsPulse {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(37,211,102,.45), 0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,.42); }
      55% { box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(37,211,102,.45), 0 0 0 18px rgba(37,211,102,0); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .whats-float { right: 16px; bottom: 16px; width: 56px; height: 56px; }
    }

    /* ===== Bar de Caipirinhas e Drinks ===== */
    .bar-drinks {
      background:
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(23,17,13,.93), rgba(74,47,34,.9)),
        url("img/happyhour-1.jpg") center/cover no-repeat;
      color: var(--white);
    }
    .bar-drinks h2, .bar-drinks .lead { color: var(--white); }

  <script>
    // Fallback leve para navegadores que não suportam animation-timeline.
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const items = document.querySelectorAll(".section-head, .card, .service, .stat, .logo-item, .founder-card, .feature-box, .portfolio-grid div, form");
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            entry.target.style.opacity = "1";
            entry.target.style.transform = "translateY(0)";
            observer.unobserve(entry.target);
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.14 });

      items.forEach((item) => {
        item.style.opacity = "0";
        item.style.transform = "translateY(28px)";
        item.style.transition = "opacity .75s ease, transform .75s ease, box-shadow .32s ease, border-color .32s ease";
        observer.observe(item);
      });
    });
  </script>


  <script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
      const toggle = document.querySelector(".mobile-toggle");
      const menu = document.querySelector(".menu");

      if (toggle && menu) {
        toggle.addEventListener("click", function () {
          menu.classList.toggle("active");
          toggle.textContent = menu.classList.contains("active") ? "×" : "☰";
        });

        menu.querySelectorAll("a").forEach(function (link) {
          link.addEventListener("click", function () {
            menu.classList.remove("active");
            toggle.textContent = "☰";
          });
        });
      }
    });
  </script>
